title: AbyssLab
description: Random items and changes for other mods
body:
## Warning!
This mod is still actively in development, things can change or even disappear, please be careful when using this mod in modpacks.

This mod adds a little bit of everything. It's main use is with the Voidcore.cc modpack and server, so any features that I add to this mod will be what I feel is currently missing or small easy pieces that I find are unnecessary to add yet another mod for, but if you like chaos, then this mod might be for you.

**Tools ⚒️**
- Wooden Paxel
- Stone Paxel
- Gold Paxel
- Iron Paxel
- Diamond Paxel
- Netherite Paxel
- Abyss Paxel

**Ores 💎**
- Abyss Ore: The strongest material of the mod, even better than netherite


I recommend using [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) to see the recipes
